stock.description: Sunac Services Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, delivering a comprehensive suite of services across the People's Republic of China. These include property management, various value-added solutions for non-property owners, commercial operations, and community lifestyle services. Its property management division oversees a diverse portfolio encompassing both residential and non-residential properties. The company's value-added offerings extend to providing sales assistance for property developers' marketing efforts at sales centers and show homes. It also furnishes consultancy, pre-delivery, and engineering expertise to other property management firms, along with property agency services for developers, particularly concerning tourism and leisure projects as well as parking facilities. Sunac Services' community living solutions encompass space management, interior design, real estate brokerage, the sale of parking space usage rights, and a range of convenience-oriented services. Additionally, the firm provides property leasing, housing repair, and commercial facility management. Established in 2004, Sunac Services Holdings Limited is headquartered in Tianjin, China.
